summary: Tested Collaboration and Agency Dashboard features. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend Agency Dashboard loads correctly with proper UI components. Agency tab visible in Demand Studio navigation.

collaborators_invite_endpoint.details: POST /api/social-sharing/collaborators/invite creates membership with company_id and status=active. Endpoint validates roles and requires authentication.

my_organizations_endpoint.details: GET /api/org/my-organizations returns list of organizations. Searches both company_id AND organization_id fields for memberships. Returns organization details, role, and is_active flag.

agency_clients_overview_endpoint.details: GET /api/agency/clients-overview returns clients list and stats. Only returns orgs where user is social_contributor or social_viewer. Stats include: total, pendingApproval, scheduledThisWeek.

agency_pending_approvals_endpoint.details: GET /api/agency/pending-approvals returns pending approval items across all client organizations.

agency_dashboard_page.details: Page at /demand-studio/agency loads correctly. Shows stats cards (Clients, Pending Approval, Scheduled This Week, Total Ideas), search input, grid/list toggle, and 'No clients yet' message when no collaborations.

agency_tab_in_menu.details: Agency tab visible in Demand Studio navigation tabs between Insights and Settings.

org_switch_endpoint.details: POST /api/org/switch/{company_id} allows switching active organization. Returns success=true on valid access.

list_collaborators_endpoint.details: GET /api/social-sharing/collaborators returns collaborators and pending_invitations for the organization.

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. User demo.agency@kora.com has no collaborator memberships, so Agency Dashboard shows 'No clients yet' as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Collaboration and Agency features are fully functional. Key endpoints: /api/social-sharing/collaborators/invite (creates membership with company_id+status=active), /api/org/my-organizations (searches both company_id and organization_id), /api/agency/clients-overview (returns clients where user is collaborator). Agency Dashboard UI at /demand-studio/agency loads correctly with all components (stats cards, search, grid/list toggle).
